title: Division and slicing
prompt: Type exactly what this program prints.

code.python:
print(7 / 2, 7 // 2, -7 // 2, 7 % 3, -7 % 3)
letters = "python"
print(letters[1:4], letters[::-1], letters[-2:])
print(letters[::2], letters[10:])
nums = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
nums[1:3] = ["a"]
print(nums)

hints: Slices never raise for out-of-range indices; slice assignment can change the length.
